Every device keeps its copy, without the changes of the others from now on.
You keep your copy; the owner removes you from the document.

Where the devices meet; it cannot read what they send
Empty: the public relays of n0, rate-limited, for trying
The devices that open the invitation work on this document with you, at the same time, wherever they are.
The devices that open the invitation keep this folder the same as yours: its notes and folders, and the ones added later.
The devices that open the invitation keep your whole library the same as yours: every note and folder, and the ones added later.
Into my library: both libraries become one
You are in: “%1$s” arrives in your library.
This folder cannot be shared: it is in a shared folder, or holds one. Stop sharing that one first.
The library cannot be shared while a folder in it is shared. Stop sharing that folder first.
The local network is not allowed for this application: allow it in %1$s.
The local network is not allowed for this application: allow it in the settings of the system.
The application does not declare the use of the local network (%1$s): the devices cannot find each other. Its developer can add it.
This device is on no local network: connect it to the same Wi-Fi as the other devices.
Looking for the devices around failed (%1$s).
Looking for the devices around failed (%1$s). Check that the local network is allowed in %2$s.
%1$s is found at %2$s but does not answer: open the application on it, on the same Wi-Fi as this device.
No device with this was found yet: open the application on the other device, in the foreground, on the same Wi-Fi.
No device with this was found yet: open the application on the other device, in the foreground, on the same Wi-Fi, and check on both that the local network is allowed in %1$s.
Far apart, or on different networks? Turn on the sync over the internet.
System Settings › Privacy & Security › Local Network

This device does not wait for the others: share or join again.
The others find this device at %1$s, and it answers there.

The announcement of this device was not seen on the network.
%1$s (%2$s) is found, but shares nothing with this device yet: join with the invitation on it.
